title: 9 December 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening) - George Martin watches The Beatles perform
content:
The Beatles’ 117th evening show at the Cavern Club took place on 9 December 1962. They were on a bill with The Fourmost, The Blue Jeans and the Zenith Six Jazz Band.

This was The Beatles’ 265th known Cavern Club performance overall. Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the underground venue took place on 3 August 1963.

Although some sources claim that George Martin watched them play on this date, he actually attended a show three days later.
